message.content: {"label": "RISKY", "explanation": "The `global_tags` context manager now uses `old_len = len(stack) - 1` (off-by-one: should be `len(stack) - 1` before appending, but `_add_global_tags` appends first and returns the stack, so `old_len` equals the index of the just-appended item rather than the pre-existing length), meaning `del stack[old_len:]` will delete the tag just added by `global_tags` itself plus any subsequently added tags, which is correct only if no tags existed before—but if nested, it could delete too many or too few entries."}
